items.title: 'The French think they know us, but they are mistaken': Colonization still clouds French-Algerian relations
items.description: 'Algeria's unhealed war memories' (3/3). Trauma continues to affect survivors and the descendants of those who suffered during the war. These wounds are tied to a sense of lost identity and dignity in the face of a French perspective that many still see as negative, paternalistic and condescending.

items.title: Trump vows Mideast deal is on, calls for no more attacks
items.description: US President Donald Trump on Sunday said Israeli strikes on Beirut "should not have happened" as he vowed a regional peace deal was at hand, though he did not confirm his earlier claim it would be signed during the day. France 24's Noga Tarnopolsky tells us more.

items.title: Trump to meet with leaders at G7 as confidence grows for Iran war deal
items.description: Pakistan says an agreement to end the Iran war is closer than ever. U.S. President Donald Trump plans to discuss demining the Strait of Hormuz at the upcoming Group of Seven summit that begins Monday.

items.title: Instability, war and closed borders: How aid workers get emergency food to hungry Afghan children
items.description: The odyssey begins in Indonesia and ends, 15,000 kilometres later, in Kabul, the capital of Afghanistan. Along the way, critical food aid destined for young Afghan students crosses nine countries, over land and sea, skirting geopolitical unrest and conflict zones.
